title: 2 ECS for plots above 250 up to 300 sqm (MPD-2047 Table 11.7, Plotted Housing b)

citations.original_text: b. 2.0 ECS in plots of size above 250-300 sqm.

notes: Read from the gazette text layer, p.222. Same as UBBL p.154 (viii.a), which the tool showed as text only. Metro and MLP deductions are 'NP' (not permitted) for plotted housing. effective_from is the date of S.O. 4597(E), as for Table 7.2. Supersedes the UBBL rule for the same plots from that date.
user_caveat: MPD-2047 Table 11.7: if the permissible FAR is not achieved with this parking norm, the norm of the smaller plot category applies. Not modelled; check with the sanctioning authority.
